topic: Mastering Binomial Distributions: From Coin Flips to Success

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Bernoulli Trial
lecture_lines: A Bernoulli trial has two outcomes.
animations: Draw a green branch #00FF00 labeled 'Success' (p) and a red branch #FF0000 labeled 'Failure' (q).
Highlight the 'Success' branch, then the 'Failure' branch to emphasize binary nature.

sections.title: Defining the Binomial Distribution
animations: Display a horizontal line of n circles #FFFFFF.
Pulse each circle #FFFF00 individually to emphasize independence.
A counter label X starting at 0 and updating as circles are marked as successes.

sections.title: The Binomial Formula: The Logic of Combinations
animations: Write the formula C(n,k) in white #FFFFFF.
Animate selecting k items from n to show combinations.
Fade in p^k #00FF00 and (1-p)^(n-k) #FF0000 next to the combination formula.
Combine all terms into the final binomial formula equation.
Flash the complete formula #FFFF00 for emphasis.

sections.title: Application: The Robot Quality Control
animations: Draw 5 robot icons in a row, coloring 3 as successes (green) #00FF00.
Animate the probability calculation text: P(X=3) =... below the robots.
Display the resulting percentage as a floating label above the robots.
Highlight the center shift when the probability parameter p changes.
Briefly flash a bar graph representing the final distribution.

sections.title: Summary & Real-World Utility
animations: Display text: Mean = np, Variance = npq in light blue #ADD8E6.
List icons representing Quality Control, Genetics, and Finance.
Show a concluding slide with 'Binomial Distribution' pulsing #FFFFFF.
